verdict.rationale: Anytime Mailbox is a virtual mailbox SaaS platform that could plausibly offer a developer or test sandbox, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no sandbox, test mode or non-production environment. Probes found no llms.txt and no OpenAPI spec, so there is no evidence of a programmatic surface that could be tested in isolation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
